info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Streaming Subscriptions Billings-v5-spec
info.description: The Streaming Subscription Billing Retrieval API enables users to access detailed billing information for their streaming subscriptions. It serves as a vital resource for customers looking to review and manage their subscription-related expenses. With this API, developers can fetch billing data for various streaming subscriptions, facilitating transparency and aiding in financial planning. Typical consumers include application developers and financial analysts who require seamless access to billing records for analysis and reporting purposes.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the billing information associated with your subscriptions. It includes details such as payment history, current charges, and upcoming billing events.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the billing information for subscriptions. It expects a JSON object conforming to the specified schema.
